extracted.name: Quick and Easy Pimento Cheese
extracted.description: This simple pimento cheese recipe is made with two types of cheese (Cheddar and Colby), pimento peppers, and a creamy salad dressing. Try it on sandwiches!
ingredient_lines: 2 (4 ounce) jars diced pimento peppers, drained
0.5 (16 ounce) jar creamy salad dressing (such as Miracle Whip®), or as needed
instruction_lines: Combine Cheddar cheese, Colby cheese, pimento peppers, salt, and pepper in a medium bowl. Stir in enough salad dressing to achieve desired texture. Mix until well combined.
